_comment: Processes the launcher starts, in order. {python} = the interpreter running the launcher. 'exists' is a path relative to the project root; the entry is skipped if it is missing. The pipeline (assistant.main) spawns the ASR and TTS MCP servers itself over stdio and auto-starts the tools server if port 8766 is silent, so it is the only required process. 'stub' entries only run when no real event publisher started.
